subject: Post-discovery: propose evaluation charter + technical deep-dive slots
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Ramos <olivia@mednexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: propose evaluation charter + technical deep-dive slots

Hi Olivia — thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. I pulled together a short evaluation charter and some concrete next steps so we can get an evaluation (trial) rolling with minimal friction. High level summary: 1) kickoff evaluation + align success criteria, 2) technical deep-dive for your infra team, 3) delivery of the prompt set and initial evals.

Proposed agenda for the 60-minute evaluation kickoff:
- 10m introductions & goals
- 15m success criteria and target datasets
- 20m trial plan (duration, access, metrics)
- 15m immediate ops/next steps (contacts, security checklist)

Technical deep-dive (recommended, 60–90m): model variants, VPC/private deployment options, token/throughput profiles, integration checklist. Ben will lead that session.

Availability: can you do any of the following for the kickoff?
- Wed Aug 11 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Aug 12 — 14:00–15:00 PT
- Fri Aug 13 — 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of those work, propose two times that do and we’ll adapt. I attached a draft trial-charter (high level) and a sample prompt pack for the kinds of evals we usually run. Ben & Marissa are looped for technical follow-up and prompt prep.

Attachments: trial-charter-v1.pdf (1.2MB), prompt-examples.xlsx (120KB)

Next steps if kickoff confirmed:
- We finalize success criteria and sample prompts during kickoff
- We provision a 2-week trial environment (Dedicated or Private) depending on your compliance needs
- Marissa will pull together the initial prompt evaluation plan and baseline metrics

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

From: Olivia Ramos <olivia@mednexa.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose evaluation charter + technical deep-dive slots

Thanks Karthik — that summary is super helpful. Tentatively the team prefers Thu Aug 12 in the afternoon, but I need to confirm with our infra lead (Diego). I can commit to Thu Aug 12 14:00 PT if Diego can join; otherwise Wed 11 at 10:00 works for most of us.

A few quick clarifications before kickoff:
- What does the 2-week trial environment include (models, token limits, data access)?
- Any specific network prerequisites for the Private deployment option?

I'll check with Diego and procurement and reply with a firm selection by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Olivia Ramos
Head of AI Integrations, MedNexa
olivia@mednexa.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Ramos <olivia@mednexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, MedNexa Procurement <procurement@mednexa.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose evaluation charter + technical deep-dive slots

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. Quick answers for your questions so you can share with Diego/procurement: 
- Trial environment: includes access to two model variants (standard and quantized), 50k token/day baseline (can be adjusted), endpoint access and streaming, and an S3-compatible bucket for ingesting evaluation datasets. We can enable prefix caching and KV cache hooks for prompt-heavy workloads.
- Private deployment network prerequisites: we require HTTPS outbound to the control plane over 443 (if you choose the Private control plane option we provide an installable package for air-gapped installs; we can discuss on the technical call).

Ben — can you prepare a short slide (3–4 bullets) on model variants and expected throughput for the Thu deep-dive? Marissa — can you draft the first-pass prompt pack we attached and a short checklist we can present during kickoff?

Olivia — ping me any time if you need a calendar invite; I can send the calendar hold once Diego confirms. If procurement needs an initial SOW or PO contact, loop them in and I’ll share our standard trial SOW.

Thanks,
Karthik
